quality.review_scope: All eight supplied main pages read and visually inspected with independent source, canonical, molecular, apparatus and reader audits. Nine Ag A–I experiments, separate Ir/Pt conditions, typical framework, common workup, unassigned microscopy/optical cohorts, prior comparisons and author models retain their distinct scope. No matched SI verified; no invented per-run masses, Pt precursor correction or atomic coordinates.
